text_block_list.text:
Tokai Teio said she wanted to take a breather,
so I brought her to karaoke, but—

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Karaoke is so fun, Trainer!
We get to sing and dance♪
And best of all—

text_block_list.name: Karaoke Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me,
here are three party snacks.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Phaaah! So satisfied!
Now then, time for the next song—

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
...Hm? What is it, Trainer?
Is there something on my face?
choice_data_list: Are you sure it's okay to eat that much?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Hmm~?
Don't tell me you're thinking you might gain weight?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
No worries, no worries!
Lady Teio is in top physical condition!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Like I'd let it get in the way of my race!

—At that moment, an upbeat, fast-tempo song began to play.
Famous for its intense dance, it was one of her favorites.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Oh! Just in the nick of time!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Come on, if you're worried, just watch! I'll show you the ultimate Teio Step!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"...Haa, haa...!
Huh, why does my body feel so hea—"

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
W-What do I do?! For now,
I'll give you all these snacks, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"A-And also, could you put together a special
diet menu for me, please?!"

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Uuuu!!
I'm definitely gonna lose weight~!!

Afterward... Tokai Teio managed to
lose the weight and get back
her brilliant "Teio Step."
